QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` (`impl.h:85`) is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` under assembly.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives the empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` with an input-output register operand and calls it an opaque barrier that stops the compiler folding branches. It never says outright that the statement emits no instruction.
